page.notes: Doubtful readings: "117.118" at the end of the "vitium" entry is marked [?], as the numerals are faint and a stray mark sits beside them. The spaced heading "I N D" is printed as shown and may be the start of a longer word. The "V" is a section letter, given as its own line. Long s is written as plain s throughout. The blue marks and underlines beside the page numbers are annotations, not printed text, and are not transcribed. The reading "cs[?]" at the head of the first line and "quæstio sita in" are doubtful; the middle of the first line is faint.
